mapper.sql: id, user_id, name, sort, create_time, update_time, deleted
mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.user_id, c.name, c.sort, c.create_time, c.update_time, c.deleted, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM note n WHERE n.category_id = c.id AND n.user_id = c.user_id AND n.deleted = 0) AS note_count FROM note_category c WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.deleted = 0 ORDER BY c.sort ASC, c.id ASC
SELECT FROM note_category WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0
SELECT FROM note_category WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND name = #{name} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO note_category (user_id, name, sort, create_time, update_time, deleted) VALUES (#{userId}, #{name}, #{sort}, NOW(), NOW(), 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE note_category SET name = #{name}, sort = #{sort}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0
